chunks.heading: Can I change plans mid-cycle?
chunks.text: Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately and you are charged a prorated amount for the rest of the billing cycle. Downgrades take effect at your next renewal date.

chunks.heading: What payment methods are accepted?
chunks.text: Credit card is accepted on the Free and Plus plans. Pro plans billed annually may also pay by ACH bank transfer against an invoice.

chunks.heading: How do I get a copy of an invoice?
chunks.text: Open the Billing page and tap the Invoices tab. Every past invoice can be downloaded as a PDF from there.

chunks.heading: What happens if a payment fails?
chunks.text: There is a 7 day grace period after a failed payment during which the hub keeps working normally. If payment still has not succeeded after 14 days, the household is automatically downgraded to the Free plan.

chunks.heading: Is footage lost when a household is auto-downgraded to Free?
chunks.text: No footage already recorded is deleted when a household is downgraded, but the Free plan retains no new cloud recordings going forward until you upgrade again.

chunks.heading: Can I get a refund?
chunks.text: Refunds are only available for charges made within the last 14 days, and are prorated based on the unused portion of the billing period.
